ModMetaData.name: Petitions
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists voice lasting grievances as concrete petitions before they snap.
Each grievance builds up from the colonist's own mood thoughts (sleeping in barracks, eating without a table, knowing about organ harvesting, and so on). The Petitions tab shows how close each colonist is to speaking up.
Work in progress: this version tracks grievance pressure. Petitions, negotiation and escalation come in later versions.
Requires RimWorld 1.7. Not safe to remove from an existing save.
